reject_rank_phrasings._comment: One-character and look-alike reshaping of a rank claim. "#1" is read as a claim in every spelling: hash + digit, hash + letter, fullwidth, numero sign, 'No. 1', '1st'.
texts: Rated the #1 sleep program in Dallas by local families.
Rated the #l sleep program in Dallas by local families.
Rated the ＃１ sleep program in Dallas by local families.
Rated the №1 sleep program in Dallas by local families.
Rated the No. 1 sleep program in Dallas by local families.
Rated the 1st sleep program in Dallas by local families.

reject_count_phrasings._comment: Count claims spelled out or in digits: a count needs a citation for that claim or it is refused.

More than 4,000 customers have joined since 2024.
